# Enforex

> > Spanish language schools across Spain and Latin America offering immersive courses, DELE/SIELE exam preparation, and cultural programs.

Enforex operates Spanish language schools in major cities including Barcelona, Madrid, Granada, Málaga, Salamanca, Valencia, Tenerife in Spain, and locations throughout Latin America including Mexico (Playa del Carmen, Oaxaca, Guanajuato), Peru, Guatemala, Cuba, and the Dominican Republic. The organization offers intensive Spanish courses, private lessons, volunteer programs, summer camps, and specialized courses combining language learning with cooking and cultural activities.

## Key Topics

- Spanish language courses
- DELE exam preparation
- SIELE certification
- Study abroad programs
- Intensive Spanish immersion
- Spanish grammar and vocabulary
- Summer camps for youth
- Volunteer programs in Latin America
- Private Spanish lessons
- Cultural immersion activities
- Host family accommodations
- Language schools in Spain
- Latin American destinations
- Spanish cooking courses
- Mediterranean study locations

## Spanish Grammar Resources

- [Spanish Pronouns](https://www.enforex.com/language/parts-pronoun.html): Spanish grammar guide covering subject, direct & indirect object pronouns
- [Learn Spanish Superlatives](https://www.enforex.com/language/spanish-superlatives.html): Spanish grammar guide to relative & absolute superlatives with adjectives
- [Pero vs Sino in Spanish](https://www.enforex.com/language/pero-sino.html): Spanish grammar guide explaining pero vs sino conjunctions in negatives
- [De vs Desde in Spanish](https://www.enforex.com/language/de-desde.html): Spanish prepositions guide explaining de vs desde usage for 'from'
